commit_message: Fix asset CLI error kind lifetime
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0121 Asset/Prefab parity with the read-only asset discovery slice.

- adds a shared project asset catalog service in engine-assets
- adds deterministic stable-ID search across manifest assets and imported sub-assets
- adds asset inspection with ProjectRoot-constrained file checks and import metadata
- exposes equivalent asset.search / asset.inspect operations through MCP and the headless CLI
- routes Editor MCP asset tools through the live Editor asset manifest
- adds shared-service, adapter-equivalence, permission, path-safety, and CLI behavior tests
- fixes compile errors found by full Windows Validation while preserving existing CLI error-code contracts

Prefab creation/instantiation remains a separate follow-up so this PR keeps the initial asset contract read-only.
